Our Lives. Our Families. Our Choices. 

Whether it's for the busy mom planning "table talk" with her family, or for the patient living with breast cancer, Consumer Education Groups television programs reach millions in the U.S. and Canada. Quite simply, we empower our audience, helping them make better choices.
